```{r}
# =============================================================================
# People counter Analysis
# =============================================================================
# Assumes: people_counter_processed is already loaded in your R environment
# Columns: CounterID, DateTime, Date, Hour, Year, Month, Day, Weekday, PedestrianIn, 
#          PedestrianOut, TotalCount, CombinedCount, MonthName, DayOfWeek, WeekNumber,TimeOfDay,
# =============================================================================
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(forecast)   # for STL decomposition + imputation
library(zoo)        # for rolling means / na.approx fallback
library(scales)
library(ggridges)
#devtools::install_github("an-bui/calecopal")
library(calecopal)
library(readxl)# read excel files
#install.packages("rstatix")
#install.packages("multcompView")
library(rstatix)
library(multcompView)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r}

df <- people_counter_processed
# Ensure Date is Date type
df$Date <- as.Date(df$Date)

#selecting all relevant columns and renaming TotalCount to PedestrianCount. PedestrainCount takes average of CombinedCount 
df_processed<- df%>%
  select(1,3:12, 14:21)%>%
  rename(PedestrianCount = TotalCount)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Cleaning data looking at how to deal with outliers
# =============================================================================

trail_data <- df_processed %>%
  mutate(
    # Ratio of the larger direction to the total - if one direction dominates, ratio approaches 1
    imbalance_ratio = pmax(PedestriansIn, PedestriansOut) / pmax(CombinedCount, 1),  # avoid div/0
    is_mismatch = imbalance_ratio > 0.95 & CombinedCount > 50,  # tune threshold + minimum volume
    PedestriansIn_clean = if_else(is_mismatch, NA_real_, PedestriansIn),
    PedestriansOut_clean = if_else(is_mismatch, NA_real_, PedestriansOut)
  )%>%
  filter(!CounterID == 'Tidepool Lot 2')
  

```

```{r}

# =============================================================================
# Date Range (07-01-2025 to 06-30-2026) CHANGE FOR ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
trail_data<- trail_data%>%
  filter(Date >= as.Date("2025-07-01") & Date <= as.Date("2026-06-30"))
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Monthly visitation graph
# =============================================================================

IRMA_monthly_visitation<- read.csv("Data/Raw/CABR_Visits_Monthly.csv", skip=3 ,header = TRUE)

IRMA_long <- IRMA_monthly_visitation %>%
  select(-Textbox5) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = JAN:DEC,
    names_to = "Month",
    values_to = "TotalVisitors"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TotalVisitors = str_replace_all(TotalVisitors, ",", ""),
    TotalVisitors = as.numeric(TotalVisitors),
    Month_num = match(Month, toupper(month.abb)),
    MonthYear_date = make_date(Year, Month_num, 1),
    MonthYear = format(MonthYear_date, "%Y-%m"),
    CounterID = "EntryStation"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TotalVisitors)) %>%
  filter(MonthYear_date >= as.Date("2025-07-01") & MonthYear_date <= as.Date("2026-06-30")) %>%
  select(CounterID, MonthYear, MonthYear_date, TotalVisitors)


monthly_summary <- trail_data %>%
  filter(is_mismatch == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(CounterID, MonthYear) %>%
  summarise(TotalVisitors = sum(CombinedCount, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(MonthYear_date = ym(MonthYear))  # converts "2025-05" -> Date (2025-05-01)

monthly_summary_combined <- monthly_summary %>%
  select(CounterID, MonthYear, MonthYear_date, TotalVisitors) %>%  # match column names/order
  bind_rows(IRMA_long)

n_locations <- n_distinct(monthly_summary_combined$CounterID)

counter_order <- c("EntryStation", "Lighthouse", "Tidepool Lot 1", "Oceanside Trail 1", "Bayside Trail")

monthly_summary_combined <- monthly_summary_combined %>%
  mutate(CounterID = factor(CounterID, levels = counter_order))

month_summary_plot <- ggplot(monthly_summary_combined, aes(x = MonthYear_date, y = TotalVisitors, color = CounterID, linetype = CounterID)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.75) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "1 month") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cal_palette(name = 'figmtn', n = n_locations, type = 'continuous')) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = setNames(
    if_else(counter_order == "EntryStation", "dashed", "solid"),
    counter_order
  )) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of visitors",
    color = "Location",
    linetype = "Location",
    title = "Monthly Visitor Counts by Location"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

month_summary_plot

# Save file
ggsave(filename = './figures/monthly_summary_plot.png',
     dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
```
```{r}
# Busiest Day Trends
# =============================================================================


# Step 1: build daily totals + calendar coordinates
calendar_data <- trail_data %>%
  filter(is_mismatch == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(CounterID, Date, DayOfWeek) %>%
  summarise(DailyVisitors = sum(PedestrianCount, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Year = year(Date),
    Week = as.numeric(format(Date, "%U")),
    Weekday = factor(DayOfWeek, 
                      levels = c("Sunday","Saturday","Friday","Thursday",
                                 "Wednesday","Tuesday","Monday"))
  )

# Step 2: flag top 10 busiest days per counter
top_flags <- calendar_data %>%
  group_by(CounterID) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = DailyVisitors, n = 10) %>%
  mutate(is_top10 = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(CounterID, Date, is_top10)

calendar_data <- calendar_data %>%
  left_join(top_flags, by = c("CounterID", "Date")) %>%
  mutate(is_top10 = replace_na(is_top10, FALSE))

# Step 3: build month break positions (week number of the 1st of each month)
month_breaks <- calendar_data %>%
  distinct(Date) %>%
  mutate(Week = as.numeric(format(Date, "%U")), Day = day(Date)) %>%
  filter(Day == 1) %>%
  mutate(MonthLabel = format(Date, "%b")) %>%
  distinct(Week, MonthLabel)

# Step 4: plot
calendar_heatmap <- ggplot(calendar_data, aes(x = Week, y = Weekday, fill = DailyVisitors)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_tile(data = filter(calendar_data, is_top10), 
            color = "black", linewidth = 0.15, fill = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = cal_palette(name = 'fire', n = 10, type = 'continuous'),
                        labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = month_breaks$Week, labels = month_breaks$MonthLabel) +
  facet_grid(CounterID ~ Year, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Daily\nVisitors",
       title = "Daily Visitor Activity by Counter",
       subtitle = "Black outlines mark each counter's 10 busiest days") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 270, face = "bold", size = 5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),  
    legend.text = element_text(size = 4), 
    legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8)
  )

calendar_heatmap

ggsave(filename = './figures/heatcalendar.png',
       width = 8, height = 4,
       dpi = 600,
       units = "in",
       bg = "white")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# Fed Holiday Comp
# =============================================================================

fed_holiday<- read_excel("./Data/Raw/OPM_holidays25_26.xlsx")

fed_holiday$Date<- as.Date(fed_holiday$Date)
  
holiday_list <- fed_holiday %>% 
  pull(Holiday) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  na.omit() %>%
  as.character()

trail_data_and_holiday <- trail_data %>%
  filter(is_mismatch == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(CounterID, Date, DayOfWeek) %>%
  summarise(DailyVisitors = sum(PedestrianCount, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(fed_holiday %>% select(Date, Holiday), by = "Date")%>%
  mutate(DayOfWeek = factor(DayOfWeek, 
                             levels = c("Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday",
                                        "Friday","Saturday","Sunday")))


counter_list <- unique(trail_data_and_holiday$CounterID)

holiday_test <- expand_grid(holiday = holiday_list, CounterID = counter_list) %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(holiday, CounterID) {
    
    holiday_rows <- trail_data_and_holiday %>% 
      filter(CounterID == !!CounterID, Holiday == !!holiday)
    if (nrow(holiday_rows) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    baseline <- trail_data_and_holiday %>%
      filter(CounterID == !!CounterID, is.na(Holiday), DailyVisitors > 0)
    if (nrow(baseline) < 3) return(NULL)
    
    holiday_val <- mean(holiday_rows$DailyVisitors)
    test <- t.test(baseline$DailyVisitors, mu = holiday_val)
    se <- sd(baseline$DailyVisitors) / sqrt(nrow(baseline))
    
    tibble(
      holiday = holiday,
      CounterID = CounterID,
      mean_dif = holiday_val - mean(baseline$DailyVisitors),
      se_dif = se,
      pval_sig = test$p.value < 0.05
    )
  })

#ggplot the long ways (vert)

ggplot(data = holiday_test) + 
  geom_col(mapping = aes(y = mean_dif, x = fct_rev(holiday), fill = mean_dif)) + 
  geom_errorbar(mapping = aes(x = fct_rev(holiday), ymin = (mean_dif - se_dif), 
                              ymax = (mean_dif + se_dif), width = 0.3),
                color =  'gray48') + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = cal_palette('bigsur2')[1], 
                        mid = '#E0B0FF', 
                        high = cal_palette('fire')[3],
                        midpoint = 0) +
  geom_text(mapping = aes(x = 12, y = -100, label = 'Fewer visitors'), 
            color = 'black', hjust = 0.95, size = 2.5) + 
  geom_text(mapping = aes(x = 12, y = 100, label = 'More visitors'), 
            color = 'black', hjust = 0, size = 2.5) + 
  geom_text(data = filter(holiday_test, pval_sig == TRUE),
            mapping = aes(x = fct_rev(holiday), y = (mean_dif + se_dif + 100), 
                          label = '*'), color = 'black') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'black') + 
  coord_flip(xlim = c(1,12)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-1000,1000, by = 500), limits = c(-1300,1300)) +
  ylab('Difference in visitation') + 
  xlab('Holiday') +
  labs(fill = 'Mean Dif')+
  facet_wrap(~ CounterID) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = 'right',
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(color = 'black', size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(color = 'black'),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# ggplot the looooong ways (horiz)

ggplot(data = holiday_test) + 
  geom_col(mapping = aes(x = fct_rev(holiday), y = mean_dif, fill = mean_dif)) + 
  geom_errorbar(mapping = aes(x = fct_rev(holiday), ymin = (mean_dif - se_dif), 
                              ymax = (mean_dif + se_dif), width = 0.3),
                color =  'gray48') + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = cal_palette('bigsur2')[1], 
                        mid = '#E0B0FF', 
                        high = cal_palette('fire')[3],
                        midpoint = 0) +
  geom_text(data = filter(holiday_test, pval_sig == TRUE),
            mapping = aes(x = fct_rev(holiday), y = (mean_dif + se_dif + 100), 
                          label = '*'), color = 'black') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'black') + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1200,1200)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-1000,1000, by = 500)) +
  xlab('Holiday') + 
  ylab('Difference in visitation') +
  facet_wrap(~ CounterID) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = 'right',
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(color = 'black', size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(color = 'black'),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))


ggsave(filename = './figures/holidays2.png',
       width = 8, height = 6,
       dpi = 600,
       units = "in",
       bg = "white")
```

```{r}


fed_holiday<-fed_holiday%>%
  filter(Date >= as.Date("2025-07-01") & Date <= as.Date("2026-06-30"))

# Step 1: build daily totals + calendar coordinates
calendar_data <- trail_data %>%
  filter(is_mismatch == FALSE) %>%
  group_by(CounterID, Date, DayOfWeek) %>%
  summarise(DailyVisitors = sum(PedestrianCount, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Year = year(Date),
    Month = factor(format(Date, "%b"), 
                    levels = c("Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec",
                               "Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun")),
    DayOfMonth = day(Date),
    # true calendar-week position: aligns days into real Mon-Sun weeks
    WeekOfMonth = as.integer(format(Date, "%W")) - 
                  as.integer(format(floor_date(Date, "month"), "%W")) + 1,
    Weekday = factor(DayOfWeek, 
                  levels = c("Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday",
                             "Friday","Saturday","Sunday"))
  )

# Step 2: flag top 10 busiest days per counter
top_flags <- calendar_data %>%
  group_by(CounterID) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = DailyVisitors, n = 10) %>%
  mutate(is_top10 = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(CounterID, Date, is_top10)

# Step 3: flag holidays
holiday_flags <- fed_holiday %>%
  filter(Holiday %in% holiday_list) %>%
  distinct(Date) %>%
  mutate(is_holiday = TRUE)

calendar_data <- calendar_data %>%
  left_join(top_flags, by = c("CounterID", "Date")) %>%
  left_join(holiday_flags, by = "Date") %>%
  mutate(
    is_top10 = replace_na(is_top10, FALSE),
    is_holiday = replace_na(is_holiday, FALSE),
    is_top10_holiday = is_top10 & is_holiday
  )

# Step 4: build one plot per CounterID, faceted by Month
counter_list <- unique(calendar_data$CounterID)

calendar_plots <- map(counter_list, function(ctr) {
  
  plot_data <- calendar_data %>% filter(CounterID == ctr)
  
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Weekday, y = WeekOfMonth, fill = DailyVisitors)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3, width = 1, height = 1) +
    geom_tile(data = filter(plot_data, is_top10), 
              color = "green", linewidth = 0.8, fill = NA) +
    geom_tile(data = filter(plot_data, is_holiday), 
              color = "blue", linewidth = 0.4, fill = NA, width = 0.5, height = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = DayOfMonth), size = 2, color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colors = cal_palette(name = 'fire', n = 10, type = 'continuous'),
                          labels = scales::comma) +
    scale_y_reverse(breaks = 1:6) +
    facet_wrap(~ Month, nrow = 3) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Daily\nVisitors",
         title = paste("Daily Visitor Activity —", ctr),
         subtitle = "Blue = federal holiday · Green = top 10 busiest days") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),  
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6), 
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8)
    )
}) %>% set_names(counter_list)

})
```
